# factory-console — architecture digest (auto-loaded for every lane)

Fast orientation for anyone touching this repo. The **authoritative** design lives in `docs/planning/` — build against those contracts, do not redesign them. This file just points you there and states the standing rules.

## Planning docs (authoritative — read before building)

- `docs/planning/VISION.md` — what and why
- `docs/planning/ARCHITECTURE.md` — shared contracts, layering, tech per layer
- `docs/planning/PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md` — directory layout — where new files go
- `docs/planning/ROADMAP.md` — milestones + per-ticket build order
- `docs/planning/tickets.json` — ticket manifest (ids, deps, provides)

## Standing rules for a lane

- Work ONLY in your assigned worktree; never touch the live tree.
- Follow the shared contracts in `ARCHITECTURE.md` — reference them, do not redefine them.
- Put new files where `PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md` says; match the existing patterns and naming.
- Your ticket file is the scope. When a "Ground truth from your dependencies" block is present, build against what those deps ACTUALLY produced.
